1 Advocate for the Petitioner : MR. L R MAZUMDER, MR. A ISLAM,MR E HUSSAIN Advocate for the Respondent : PP, ASSAM,
 BEFORE  HONOURABLE MRS. JUSTICE MITALI THAKURIA  ORDER 11.12.2024 Heard Mr. L. R. Mazumder, learned counsel for the petitioners.

Also heard Ms. S. H.
Borah, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for State respondent No.1.

This application is filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023,
praying for a stay of the further proceedings in connection with Gauripur P.S. Case No. 1233/2018 under Sections 365/376/372/511/34 of the IPC, corresponding to G.R. Case No. 4907/2018,
charge-sheet No. 657/2023 dated 28.11.2023, and also the proceedings in PRC Case No.
2098/2024, registered under Sections 366/372/511/34 of the IPC, which are pending before the Court of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dhubri.
Issue notice to the respondents, returnable after 3(three) weeks.
Since Ms. Borah, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, has entered appearance and accepted notice on behalf of the State respondent No.1, no formal notice is required to be issued to the said respondent.
However, she shall be furnished with the requisite extra-copy of the petition during the course of the day.
Page No.# 3/3 The learned counsel for the petitioners shall take steps for service of notice upon the respondent No. 2 by registered post with A/D as well as by usual process.

It is submitted by Mr. Mazumder, learned counsel for the petitioners, that the matter has already been compromised between the parties, and, therefore, he prays for a stay of the aforesaid proceedings until the disposal of the instant petition.

Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioners, the further proceedings in connection with Gauripur P.S. Case No. 1233/2018 under Sections 365/376/372/511/34 of the IPC, corresponding to G.R. Case No. 4907/2018, charge-sheet No.
657/2023 dated 28.11.2023, and also the proceedings in PRC Case No. 2098/2024, registered under Sections 366/372/511/34 of the IPC, which are pending before the Court of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dhubri, stands stayed till the next date of listing.
Also, call for the scanned copy of the LCR.
List the matter immediately after Vacation.
